dedupe_keys.name: analysis ready spatial data on informal urban conditions climate exposure and malaria burden across sub saharan africa

description: The project team publishes processed spatial data on informal urban conditions and climate exposure across sub-Saharan Africa. Zenodo supplies a data archive and README free under CC BY 4.0. The package documents 4,320 administrative units, forty-four boundary features, annual heat-exposure rasters for 2011–2020, a slum-population grid and mapped malaria-burden indicators. Dictionaries, raster metadata, provenance, rights notes and checksums support reuse. These layers can inform hazard exposure and health-service demand simulations in vulnerable settlements. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this processed collection. Coverage uses harmonised administrative and population grids, not household measurements. A limitation is that original upstream flood and malaria layers are not redistributed; mapped malaria values derive from administrative means. The linked MIT code is separately licensed and the manuscript is in preparation. No archive was downloaded or health association reproduced.
